gate: Rehman 2021 processed-count header and Figure-4 sample identity audit
permitted_operations: download and hash exact compressed source files
read only the first decompressed line of the counts file
parse GEO sample accession, title, and characteristics from SOFT metadata
map count-header columns to GEO sample titles/accessions

prospective_mapping_rule.control: three saline_8w samples plus four non-barcoded CTRL1-CTRL4 DMSO samples if and only if their GEO characteristics identify them as vehicle controls and this yields the paper-native n=7
prospective_mapping_rule.dtp: three cpt11_8w samples if GEO characteristics identify them as CPT-11 DTP/on-treatment samples
prospective_mapping_rule.regrowth: three cpt11_regrowth samples if GEO characteristics identify them as CPT-11 regrowth/post-cessation samples
prospective_mapping_rule.barcoded_DMSO_samples: exclude from Figure-4 primary event if the above source-derived mapping uniquely resolves n=7 control; retain as source-available sensitivity only, not primary
